data.label: Private data subnet A (no internet route)
Private data subnet B (no internet route)
Route 53
data.notes: Alias A/AAAA records: site to CloudFront, origin.<domain> to the ALB. ACM certificates validated by DNS.

data.label: CloudFront
data.notes: HTTPS only. Default behaviour: S3 frontend (cached). /api/*: ALB, caching disabled, forwards Authorization.

data.label: AWS WAF
data.notes: AWS managed common + bad-inputs rules, 100k req / 5 min per-IP flood limit (campus shares one IP).

data.label: Cognito user pool
data.notes: Groups student / tutor / admin. Admin-created users only. ID token 60 min.

data.label: S3 frontend bucket
data.notes: Private, readable only by CloudFront (OAC). TLS only. SSE-S3.

data.label: AWS Backup
data.notes: Monthly RDS copy kept 1,826 days (5 years).

data.label: Application Load Balancer (both AZs)
data.notes: Public subnets A and B. HTTPS listener with ACM cert. Health check /health every 10 s. Only accepts CloudFront (prefix list + secret header).

data.label: API tasks on Fargate (AZ-A)
data.notes: Node.js API, 0.5 vCPU / 1 GB. Shown at the exam-window floor: 3 tasks here + 3 in AZ-B. Normal days 1 + 1, max 12 total.

data.label: API tasks on Fargate (AZ-B)
data.notes: Same ECS service as AZ-A. ECS spreads the tasks evenly across both AZs.

data.label: Lambda marking-fn
data.notes: VPC-attached to both app subnets. Auto-marks MCQs. Timeout 30 s, max concurrency 5.

data.label: Lambda upload-fn
data.notes: VPC-attached to both app subnets. Records the submission, asks for the tutor email. Timeout 30 s.

data.label: S3 gateway endpoint
data.notes: Free. Keeps S3 traffic off the NAT gateways.

data.label: RDS PostgreSQL primary
data.notes: Multi-AZ primary. db.m6g.large in production. KMS encrypted, TLS forced, PITR 7 days.

data.label: RDS PostgreSQL standby
data.notes: Synchronous standby. Promoted automatically if AZ-A fails (1 to 2 min).

data.label: S3 uploads bucket
data.notes: Presigned POST, 50 MB limit enforced by S3. Versioned. IA at 30 d, Glacier at 365 d, deleted at 1,826 d.

data.label: Secrets Manager
data.notes: Database password, injected into tasks at start.

data.label: SQS uploads queue
data.notes: Receives S3 ObjectCreated events. Visibility 180 s.

data.label: KMS key
data.notes: Customer managed key, yearly rotation.

data.label: SQS marking queue
data.notes: Visibility timeout 180 s.

data.label: Dead-letter queues
data.notes: One per queue, after 3 failed receives. Alarm fires on any message.

data.label: SQS email queue
data.notes: Visibility timeout 180 s.

data.label: Lambda email-fn
data.notes: Outside the VPC, no database access needed. Timeout 30 s.

data.label: Amazon SES
data.notes: Sends result and submission emails.

data.label: CloudWatch
data.notes: Logs, dashboard, alarms (5xx, latency, unhealthy hosts, DLQ, RDS CPU).

data.label: SNS alarm topic
data.notes: Emails the on-call admin.

data.label: ECR (API image)
data.notes: Image tagged with the git commit SHA, scanned on push.

data.label: EventBridge (5 min sweep)
data.notes: Auto-submits attempts whose time ran out.

data.label: GitHub Actions (CI/CD)
data.notes: Push to main: tests, terraform apply, build and push image, rolling ECS deploy.
